description: Ground-truth set for RAGAS evaluation of the Bible RAG assistant. Each case has a reference (gold) answer used by reference-based metrics (context precision/recall). Only answerable questions are included; refusal behaviour is covered by the custom harness in evaluate.py.

cases.question: What is the greatest commandment?
cases.reference: To love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and mind, and to love your neighbour as yourself.

cases.question: Who was swallowed by a great fish?
cases.reference: Jonah was swallowed by a great fish.

cases.question: What did God create on the first day?
cases.reference: On the first day God created light and divided the light from the darkness.

cases.question: Who led the Israelites out of Egypt?
cases.reference: Moses led the Israelites out of Egypt.

cases.question: Where was Jesus born?
cases.reference: Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea.

cases.question: Who was thrown into the lions' den?
cases.reference: Daniel was thrown into the lions' den.

cases.question: What are the first words of the Bible?
cases.reference: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

cases.question: What did Moses receive on Mount Sinai?
cases.reference: Moses received the Ten Commandments (the tables of stone) on Mount Sinai.

cases.question: Who was the strong man whose strength was in his hair?
cases.reference: Samson, whose strength was in his hair.

cases.question: How did God create man?
cases.reference: God formed man of the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and man became a living soul.

cases.question: Who was the mother of Jesus?
cases.reference: Mary was the mother of Jesus.

cases.question: What happened when the people built the Tower of Babel?
cases.reference: God confounded their language so they could not understand one another, and scattered them across the earth.
